obligor_aliases: Rady Children's Hospital and Health Center
_notes: Pediatric quaternary hospital, San Diego. Strong credit. Affiliated with UC San Diego. CHOC merger closed Dec 31 2024 — new parent: Rady Children's Health. Pre-merger Moody's Aa3 stable, Fitch AA-, S&P not confirmed.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's affirmed Rady Children's Aa3 rating, citing the hospital's dominant market position, strong balance sheet and favorable reputation. The outlook is stable.

sp.citation_text: No S&P public rating confirmed within budget.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch upgraded Rady Children's bond rating to AA- prior to window; assigned AA IDR per Fitch with stable outlook. Pre-window AA- per Rady IR; subsequent assignment confirmed AA-equivalent strength.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Rady Children's Hospital-San Diego and CHOC (Orange County) completed merger forming Rady Children's Health parent. Rating implications: agencies likely affirmed pre-existing strong ratings on legacy obligated groups; no public downgrade identified in window.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Children's Hospital of Orange County (CHOC) and Rady Children's Hospital San Diego Announce Closing of Merger; finalized Dec 31 2024.

moodys.citation_text: Aa3 stable carried through window; no public downgrade identified post-merger close.

outcome_class_rationale: No notch rating change identified in window; strong credit. Merger closed end of window with no immediate rating action visible. Control name — high credit quality, should NOT be flagged by detectors.
